test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 08 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Two Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All tables are strong.

No strong is weak.

**Conclusions:**

I. No tables are weak.

II. Some weak are tables.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
Given Statements:

All tables are strong.

No strong is weak.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8cb6c9db019ba608843538952d911651a13cf04e14c1b64a21396e7f7e21be0a.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No tables are weak - True (Because, All the tables are strong and no strong is weak, so no tables are weak).

II. Some weak are tables - False (Because, All the tables are strong and no strong is weak, so no tables are weak).

So, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
